queries.sql: SELECT u.*, r.code AS role_code, r.libelle AS role_libelle, s.nom AS service_nom, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', sup.prenom, sup.nom)) AS superieur_nom FROM `utilisateurs` `u` JOIN `roles` `r` ON `r`.`id` = `u`.`role_id` LEFT JOIN `services` `s` ON `s`.`id` = `u`.`service_id` LEFT JOIN `utilisateurs` `sup` ON `sup`.`id` = `u`.`superieur_id` ORDER BY `u`.`nom` ASC
